items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I went up to the Strand where Bill Rank was playing with Shilkret Childrick (phonetic) and I went in and talked to him

ctx.x: think I can get in his place? " I don't know. We had a good trombone player in the Goldkette band, Bill Rank, fine, Good, can you get him? " Oh, I think so .

Anyway it was from Chicago I came back to New York and I went up to the Strand where Bill Rank was playing with Shilkret Childrick (phonetic) and I went in and talked to him and he was tickled to death. Oh, yeah, he'd go. So he joined the band then, someplace on the road. Tommy played for a couple of places after that and Tommy was great. He had a little E-flat -- I think E-flat or C-trumpet about that big, that he used to go around playing all kinds of Louis's choruses. He had every one of them memorized, and he…
The guys used to like to hear him.
